camel_example: aliyun dcdn PutDcdnKv --region cn-hangzhou --Value value1 --Namespace ns1 --Key key1
description_en: The PutDcdnKv operation sets a key-value (KV) pair for a specified namespace
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn put-dcdn-kv --namespace ns1 --key key1 --value value1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PutDcdnKv

parameters.help_en: The name of the key that you want to set. The key can be up to 512 characters in length and cannot contain spaces or backslashes (/)
parameters.help_zh: 需要设置的Key名称，最长不超过512个字符，不能包含空格、反斜杠（/）
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The content of the key. The maximum size is 2 MB (2 × 1,000 × 1,000 bytes)
parameters.name: value

parameters.help_en: The expiration time. This is a UNIX timestamp in seconds and cannot be earlier than the current time. If you set both Expiration and ExpirationTtl, ExpirationTtl takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 过期时间（秒级时间戳，不能小于当前时间），同时设置Expiration和ExpirationTtl时，以ExpirationTtl为准
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en: The expiration time. This is a relative time in seconds. If you set both Expiration and ExpirationTtl, ExpirationTtl takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 过期时间（相对时间，单位：秒），同时设置Expiration和ExpirationTtl时，以ExpirationTtl为准
parameters.name: expiration_ttl

Value.description_en: The content of the key. If the value exceeds 256 characters in length, the system returns the first 100 characters and the last 100 characters, with the middle part omitted
Value.description_zh: Key的内容， 超过256个字符长度，将取前100及后100字符并省略中间
